question: Who launched the second edition of the Brazil–India Cross-Incubation Programme in Agritech (Maitri 2.0)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR).**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR) launched Maitri 2.0, the second edition of the Brazil-India Cross-Incubation Programme in Agritech.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The programme was launched by the Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR) in New Delhi.**
 
• Maitri 2.0 is a two-way learning platform between Indian and Brazilian innovators.
 
• The programme aims to foster co-incubation and collaboration in sustainable agriculture and digital tech.
 
• The strategic initiative aligns with the shared goals of both India and Brazil in agriculture, technology, and food security.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR)__

 __
 
• Founded in - 1929
 
• HQ - New Delhi, India
 
• Objective - Promoting agricultural research and development
 
 
 
• Brazilian Ministry of Agriculture__
 
 
• Established in - 1860
 
• HQ - Brasília, Brazil
 
• Focus - Agricultural policy and rural development
